page: Vultr voc-s-32c-256gb-5760s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute instance built on the x86_64 architecture using AMD EPYC processors running at a base clock speed of 2.0 GHz. The instance provides 32 dedicated vCPUs across 16 physical cores with simultaneous multithreading enabled. The CPU cache architecture comprises 32 KB L1 data cache, 0.5 MB L2 cache, and 32 MB L3 cache per core cluster, with hardware support for AES and SHA-NI cryptographic operations, BMI2, and AVX instructions, while lacking AVX-512 and AMX extensions.

The configuration provides 256 GB of system RAM, yielding a high ratio of 8 GB per vCPU. Uncached memory throughput reaches top-tier benchmark tiers, registering 515.15 GB/sec on large-block reads and 253.87 GB/sec on writes. High-capacity local storage is bundled directly into the instance with 5,760 GB of NVMe SSD capacity, providing fast, low-latency access for data-heavy storage requirements without external volumes. Network connectivity includes a single complimentary public IPv4 address, and no discrete GPUs are included.

Benchmark results demonstrate strong parallel compute and memory throughput. The instance recorded a multi-core stress-ng score of 99,520.25 and a PassMark CPU score of 63,855.09, placing it in the top 25 percent of tested configurations. Redis SET operations reached 70.76 million operations per second, supported by the large memory capacity and high bandwidth. However, single-threaded metrics, including Geekbench single-core at 1,776 and standard gzip compression at 29.23 GB/sec, fall into the median range due to the conservative 2.0 GHz base clock speed.

Given its combination of substantial memory capacity, 5.76 TB of local NVMe storage, and dedicated multi-core compute, voc-s-32c-256gb-5760s-amd delivers high resource density for workloads constrained by memory footprint and I/O. Best-fit deployments include large in-memory key-value databases like Redis, transactional relational database management systems, data aggregation, multi-threaded compilation pipelines, and container virtualization clusters.
description: Vultr voc-s-32c-256gb-5760s-amd is an Optimized Cloud Compute server powered by dedicated AMD EPYC x86_64 processors running at 2.0 GHz across 32 vCPUs and 16 physical cores. It features 256 GB of RAM, establishing an 8 GB per vCPU ratio, alongside 5,760 GB of integrated local NVMe SSD storage and one complimentary public IPv4 address, with no GPU hardware present. Benchmark evaluations highlight top-tier uncached memory read bandwidth exceeding 515 GB/sec and strong multi-core processing throughput, alongside over 70 million Redis SET operations per second. While single-thread clock-sensitive tasks exhibit median performance, the instance delivers high resource density and data throughput for memory-heavy and disk-intensive deployments. It is suited for large in-memory caches, enterprise relational databases, distributed data processing, CI/CD compilation pipelines, and transactional backend architectures.
